learning_outcomes.text: Students will know in detail phases and models of information systems development including agile methods, clean code principles.
Students will be able to read and draw basic UML diagrams.
Students will be able to use design patterns.
Students will understand and use software version control systems.
Students will have experienced a complete information system development from requirements specification till deployment team project with combined model of development.
Students will have acquired the skills and experiences of team cooperation and communication.
Students will be acquainted with elementary principles of and social and ethical aspects of information technology.
Students will learn about running a business and launching startups.

syllabus_topics: Stages in development of information system
Social and ethical aspects of information technology
Introduction to running business and launching startups

assessment_methods.method: practical exam (video presentation about the realized project)

assessment_rules: Approximate grading: A 90%, B 82%, C 73%, D 64%, E 55%. The scale of assessment is preliminary/final: 50/50.
